name: Maven
description: Build, test and analyse your [Maven](https://maven.apache.org/)-based projects

variables.name: MAVEN_IMAGE
variables.description: The Docker image used to run Maven - **set the version required by your project**

variables.name: MAVEN_PROJECT_DIR
variables.description: Maven project root directory

variables.name: MAVEN_CFG_DIR
variables.description: The Maven configuration directory

variables.name: MAVEN_SETTINGS_FILE
variables.description: The Maven `settings.xml` file path

variables.name: MAVEN_OPTS
variables.description: [Global Maven options](http://maven.apache.org/configure.html#maven_opts-environment-variable)

variables.name: MAVEN_CLI_OPTS
variables.description: Additional [Maven options](https://maven.apache.org/ref/3-LATEST/maven-embedder/cli.html) used on the command line

variables.name: MAVEN_BUILD_ARGS
variables.description: Maven arguments for the build & test job

features.name: SONAR
features.description: Code quality and security analysis with [SONARQube](https://www.sonarqube.org/)

variables.name: SONAR_HOST_URL
variables.description: SonarQube server url

variables.name: SONAR_TOKEN
variables.description: SonarQube authentication token (see https://docs.sonarsource.com/sonarqube-server/user-guide/managing-tokens/) - depends on your authentication method

variables.name: SONAR_LOGIN
variables.description: SonarQube login (depends on your authentication method)

variables.name: SONAR_PASSWORD
variables.description: SonarQube password (depends on your authentication method)

variables.name: SONAR_BASE_ARGS
variables.description: SonarQube [analysis arguments](https://docs.sonarsource.com/sonarqube-server/analyzing-source-code/analysis-parameters/)

variables.name: SONAR_QUALITY_GATE_ENABLED
variables.description:
Enables SonarQube [Quality Gate](https://docs.sonarsource.com/sonarqube-server/quality-standards-administration/managing-quality-gates/introduction/) verification.

_Uses `sonar.qualitygate.wait` parameter ([see doc](https://docs.sonarsource.com/sonarqube-server/analyzing-source-code/ci-integration/overview/#quality-gate-fails))._

variables.name: MAVEN_DEPENDENCY_CHECK_ARGS
variables.description: Maven arguments for Dependency Check job

features.name: Snapshot dependencies verification
features.description: This job verifies your project has no _snapshot_ dependencies. Failure is allowed in feature branches.

features.name: Software Bill of Materials
features.description: This job generates a file listing all dependencies using [cyclonedx-maven-plugin](https://github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-maven-plugin)

variables.name: TBC_SBOM_MODE
variables.description: Controls when SBOM reports are generated (`onrelease`: only on `$INTEG_REF`, `$PROD_REF` and `$RELEASE_REF` pipelines; `always`: any pipeline)

variables.name: MAVEN_SBOM_GEN_ARGS
variables.description: Maven command used for SBOM analysis

variables.name: MAVEN_DEPLOY_ARGS
variables.description: Maven arguments for the deploy job

variables.name: MAVEN_DEPLOY_FROM_UNPROTECTED_DISABLED
variables.description: Set to limit snapshot publication to protected branches

variables.name: MAVEN_DEPLOY_SNAPSHOT_WITH_SLUG_ENABLED
variables.description: Enable to inject the Git branch slug in SNAPSHOT versions

variables.name: MAVEN_RELEASE_ARGS
variables.description: Maven arguments for the release job

variables.name: MAVEN_RELEASE_VERSION
variables.description:
Explicit version to use when triggering a release

_Otherwise uses the current snapshot version from `pom.xml`)_

variables.name: MAVEN_RELEASE_SCM_COMMENT_PREFIX
variables.description: Maven release plugin [scmCommentPrefix](https://maven.apache.org/maven-release/maven-release-plugin/prepare-mojo.html#scmCommentPrefix) parameter

variables.name: MAVEN_RELEASE_SCM_RELEASE_COMMENT
variables.description:
Maven release plugin [scmReleaseCommitComment](https://maven.apache.org/maven-release/maven-release-plugin/prepare-mojo.html#scmReleaseCommitComment) parameter

(since Maven `3.0.0-M1`)

variables.name: MAVEN_RELEASE_SCM_DEV_COMMENT
variables.description:
Maven release plugin [scmDevelopmentCommitComment](https://maven.apache.org/maven-release/maven-release-plugin/prepare-mojo.html#scmDevelopmentCommitComment) parameter

(since Maven `3.0.0-M1`)

variables.name: MVN_SEMREL_RELEASE_DISABLED
variables.description: Disable semantic-release integration

variables.name: GIT_USERNAME
variables.description: Git username (if you wish to release using Git credentials)

variables.name: GIT_PASSWORD
variables.description: Git password (if you wish to release using Git credentials)

variables.name: GIT_PRIVATE_KEY
variables.description: Git private SSH key (if you wish to release using SSH key or GitLab Deploy Key)

variables.name: GIT_SIGNING_KEY_GPG
variables.description: Git GPG signing key to use for commit signing (global TBC variable)

variables.name: GIT_SIGNING_KEY_SSH
variables.description: Git SSH signing key to use for commit signing (global TBC variable)

variables.name: MAVEN_REPOSITORY_USERNAME
variables.description: Maven repository username (inject in your settings.xml as ${env.MAVEN_REPOSITORY_USERNAME})

variables.name: MAVEN_REPOSITORY_PASSWORD
variables.description: Maven repository password (inject in your settings.xml as ${env.MAVEN_REPOSITORY_PASSWORD})

variants.name: Jib
variants.description: Build Docker and OCI images for your Java applications with [Jib](https://github.com/GoogleContainerTools/jib)

variables.name: MAVEN_TRIVY_IMAGE
variables.description: The docker image used to scan images with Trivy

variables.name: MAVEN_TRIVY_ARGS
variables.description: Additional [`trivy image` options](https://trivy.dev/docs/latest/references/configuration/cli/trivy_image/#options)

features.name: Maven Software Bill of Materials
features.description: This job generates a file listing all dependencies using [syft](https://github.com/anchore/syft)

variables.name: MAVEN_SBOM_OPTS
variables.description: Options for syft used for SBOM analysis

variables.name: MAVEN_JIB_SNAPSHOT_IMAGE
variables.description: Maven Jib Snapshot image

variables.name: MAVEN_JIB_RELEASE_IMAGE
variables.description: Maven Jib Release image

variables.name: MAVEN_SKOPEO_IMAGE
variables.description: The image used to publish images with Skopeo

variables.name: MAVEN_JIB_BUILD_ARGS
variables.description: [Jib Maven Plugin arguments](https://github.com/GoogleContainerTools/jib/tree/master/jib-maven-plugin#extended-usage)

variables.name: MAVEN_JIB_PROD_PUBLISH_STRATEGY
variables.description: Defines the publish to production strategy.

variables.name: MAVEN_JIB_PUBLISH_ARGS
variables.description: Additional [`skopeo copy` arguments](https://github.com/containers/skopeo/blob/master/docs/skopeo-copy.1.md#options)

variables.name: TBC_VAULT_IMAGE
variables.description: The [Vault Secrets Provider](https://gitlab.com/to-be-continuous/tools/vault-secrets-provider) image to use

variables.name: VAULT_BASE_URL
variables.description: The Vault server base API url

variables.name: VAULT_OIDC_AUD
variables.description: The `aud` claim for the JWT

variables.name: VAULT_ROLE_ID
variables.description: The [AppRole](https://www.vaultproject.io/docs/auth/approle) RoleID

variables.name: VAULT_SECRET_ID
variables.description: The [AppRole](https://www.vaultproject.io/docs/auth/approle) SecretID
